title: Real School Curriculum Drives Every Practice Set | vitalii.no
description:
How the real Norwegian school curriculum - 634 lesson units across three subjects and nine grades - became the foundation every homework set is built from.

Boytasks generated grade-level practice from weak topics and spaced-repetition state, but it never looked at what each child's class was actually studying that week. Two systems ran in parallel: the real school program, and an AI picking topics with no idea what was due in class.

A Cloudflare Workers routine now resolves each child's curriculum unit for the current ISO school week before a set is generated, drawing on 634 hand-written units covering Norwegian, English and Maths across grades 1 to 9. The unit becomes mandatory - about 70 percent of each day's items come straight from it - while weak topics and spaced repetition fill the remaining 30 percent instead of competing with the week's lesson.

A new admin endpoint now shows exactly what each subject covers before a set is even generated, and the worker bundle holding all three curricula still fits comfortably under its 1 MB size limit.
